Hi Sara / Tom — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood for model serving and inference cost predictability for Alegra’s patient-facing recommendation models.
- Key concerns: cold-start latency for sparse traffic, KV-cache persistence, and compliance around audit logs/data residency.
- Success criteria: <10% tail-latency improvement vs current infra on p95 for 512-token runs, and clear path to <50% per-token cost reduction via batching/caching.

Immediate next step: schedule a 60–90 minute technical run-through with our ML/infra team to walk architecture, run a short live Q&A, and align on a pilot scope. Suggested attendees from our side: Marissa (ML Infra lead) + Priyom (Solutions Eng).
